text:
ellen.r: Heads-up: postmortem posted for metering blip on 2026-01-15. Putting follow-up tasks here. Link in #docs.
tom.h: Quick TL;DR for those short on time?
ellen.r: TL;DR: transient duplicate ingest after consumer restart + replayed batches. About 850k duplicated tokens across 3 customers; affected invoices dated Jan 16. Root cause: replay without de-dupe + consumer offset commit race.
ada.k: who is owning customer credits & invoice reissues?
ada.k: (typo) sorry, ada.k meant.
mike.b: billing-ops will own credits. I created ticket BILL-5001 for crediting and invoice reissue. ETA for credits: 72h.
ad a.k: ada.k: please confirm scope: which accounts?
mike.b: accounts: C889, C990, C1011. I'll attach ledger extract to ticket.
tom.h: Ops tasks?
ops-bot: New incident task created: INF-991 "metering consumer replay fix" assigned to tom.h, due 2026-01-22.
tom.h: INF-991 will include: fix consumer commit ordering, add idempotency checks, add an integration test to replay streams. PR target in 48h.
ad a.k: Backfill plan?
ellen.r: Backfill approach: snapshot ledger -> run dedupe pass -> compute delta -> issue credits. Backfill owner: ada.k. Run window proposed: Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC.
ad a.k: SQL snippet for dedupe (staging): ```-- find duplicate event hashes
SELECT account_id, event_hash, COUNT(*) as dup_count
FROM metering.events
WHERE received_at >= '2026-01-15T00:00:00Z' AND received_at < '2026-01-16T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY account_id, event_hash
HAVING dup_count > 1;```
ada.k: (typo again) ada.k: I'll push staging job and share results before prod run. Snapshot saved to s3://billing-snapshots/2026-01-15-ledger.json.gz
ellen.r: Customer comms owner?
mike.b: I will draft comms + legal review. Proposed message: apology + explanation + credits applied + contact for escalation. Legal requested no language about systemic liability.
tom.h: Monitoring: add long consumer lag alert + sudden token-rate spike alert. Also emit metric dedupe_suspect when duplicates detected by dedupe job. Owner: tom.h.
ad a.k: Can we have an automated reconciliation CSV after backfill? I want fields: account_id, original_tokens, deduped_tokens, delta, credit_amount.
mike.b: yes. billing-ops will attach CSV to ticket BILL-5001.
ops-bot: BILL-5001 status updated: credits queued for C889.
tom.h: Notes for durable fixes: 1) event_id in ingest proto + unique index, 2) consumer commit-after-store, 3) bounded replay window per-account.
ellen.r: Risk note: this pattern can reoccur if restarts + at-least-once delivery coincide. Treat as "ingest-replay" hazard class. Add to risk registry.
ad a.k: QA checklist for backfill: 1) full ledger snapshot taken 2) run dedupe on staging 3) review sample invoices for each account 4) publish audit CSV 5) notify customers and post credits.
mike.b: Doing draft templates now, will ping legal.
tom.h: Can infra do a temporary ingestion throttle for large spikes during the next 7 days? reduces blast radius while fixes land.
ops-bot: Task INF-992 "short-term ingestion throttle" created, owner infra-sre, due 2026-01-19.
ellen.r: I'll run daily standup notes here at 16:00 UTC until closure. If any item slips >48h, escalate to Finance lead.
ad a.k: After backfill, we'll run reconciliation metric: reconciled_delta = sum(delta) per-account. Any account with abs(delta) > 2000 tokens flagged for manual review.
mike.b: Confirming: will apply full credit for duplicated usage + goodwill credit 5% for impacts > $200. Legal approved.
tom.h: OK. ask: who confirms final invoice numbers to send to customers?
mike.b: billing-ops confirms final invoice reissue numbers; I'll post proof PDF to ticket.
ellen.r: thanks all. tagging owners: @ada.k @tom.h @mike.b. Keep updates short.
ops-bot: BILL-5001 comment: credits posted for C889.
ellen.r: noted, updating action table: BILL-5001 partial complete; INF-991 in review; INF-992 scheduled. Meeting in 30 days to verify no regression.
